company.name: Variant, Inc
company.shortDescription: Variant, Inc is a company that licenses the use of its enterprise online experimentation platform with verification analytics.
company.description:
Modern enterprises, whose revenue, at least in part, comes from their human-facing software applications, such as eCommerce, depend on online controlled experiments in making key product decisions. Historically, these decisions have been informed by experience and intuition, but in recent years this approach is increasingly replaced with empirical, data-driven validation. 

Variant’s Experiment Server provides enterprises with a platform to conduct sophisticated, full-stack, feature-grained interactive experiments with the goal of enabling empirical verification of new product features via randomized controlled experiments. 

Features include: 

  * Instrument any code path for a randomized controlled experiment. 
  * Declarative instrumentation. 
  * Real time integration with operational data. 
  * Full support for concurrent experiments. 
  * Highly extensible.
